The '''Committee on Transportation and Public Safety''' was a legislative panel of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] active during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

In [[3639 BBY]],<ref name="3639BBY">{{TOR_updates|1.1}}</ref> after several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of deliberation, the committee passed regulations including an adjustment to [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] license costs. It was expected that once the regulations were signed by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] in the following [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], Tier I and II speeder license prices across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] would decline significantly. To offset the loss of revenue generated by these licenses, taxes on all Tier III speeder models were significantly increased once the new regulation took effect. Critics claimed the resolution would further strain the Republic's finances while others saw it as an attempt to keep pace with a similar law passed around the same time by the empire's [[Imperial Transportation Authority]].<ref name="ECiP115" />

==Behind the scenes==
The committee was briefly mentioned in a blog post on swtor.com in [[2012]].<ref name="ECiP115" />
